_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description:
The source draft is restored after return, and the viewed draft is kept separate. The test seeded the conversation at /c/{{ORIGINAL_SLUG}} and a draft conversation {{VIEWED}} with the draft text "Seeded text in the viewed draft.". The page fakes the microphone, screen capture and MediaRecorder, and window.__recordingMock counts what the page asked for (read it with eval, e.g. "window.__recordingMock.recorderStarts"): displayRequests (screen captures requested), synchronousDisplayRequests (those requested inside a click or keydown handler), microphoneRequests, audioSources, recorderStarts, recorderStops and stoppedTracks (media tracks stopped). "The recording state" is the data-state attribute of ".recording-status". To "select conversation X from the drawer": if the button with aria-label "Open conversations" is visible, click it; then wait for ".conversation-item[data-conversation-id=\"X\"]" to be visible, click it, and wait until it has the class "active". Recording uploads are counted by call "uploads". The message input is [data-testid="message-input"], the voice button [data-testid="voice-button"], the recording panel [data-testid="recording-panel"], and its stop, cancel and retry buttons [data-testid="recording-stop-button"], [data-testid="recording-cancel-button"] and [data-testid="recording-retry-button"]. When a step says an element should contain or have some text, assert that on that element, not with a page-wide wait_text. Perform the steps in order. 
1. Navigate to /c/{{ORIGINAL_SLUG}} and wait up to 30s for the message input to be visible. Fill it with "Restore this source text after cancellation.".
2. Click the voice button. The recording panel should be visible.
3. Select conversation {{VIEWED}} from the drawer. The message input should have the value "Seeded text in the viewed draft.".
4. Fill it with "Edited and read text in the viewed draft.". It should have that value.
5. Click [data-testid="recording-return-button"]. The URL should end with "/c/{{ORIGINAL_SLUG}}".
6. Click the cancel button. The message input should have the value "Restore this source text after cancellation.".
7. Select conversation {{VIEWED}} from the drawer. The message input should have the value "Edited and read text in the viewed draft.".
8. Call "uploads" must return "0".
